'''Warp Pack: Holiday 2017''' is the 33rd virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on December 1, 2017. The set consists of 10 cards.

Card numbering sequence continues from '''Pre-Warp Pack'''.

==Type Breakdown==
*1 [[:Category:Event (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Event]]
*1 [[:Category:Incident (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Incident]]
*8 [[:Category:Personnel (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Personnel]] (1 Bajoran, 1 Borg, 3 Federation, 1 Hirogen, 1 Klingon, 1 Non-Aligned, and 2 Vidiian)

'''NOTE: ''' There are 2 Dual Affiliation cards, thus the totals are higher than the amount of a card type.

==Rarity Breakdown==
*10 [[:Category:Virtual (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Virtual]]
